en: Located on the 3rd floor of the Finance Building.
ComLab 1 is the first laboratory you will see.
You may use either the elevator or the stairs to reach the floor.
ceb: Nahimutang sa 3rd floor sa Finance Building.
Ang ComLab 1 mao ang una makita nga laboratory.
Pwede ka mogamit sa elevator o stairs para moabot sa floor.

en: Located on the 1st floor of the Secondary School Laboratory Building.
This building is beside the University Press Building and in front of the parking area along P.A. Ramos Street.
Once you reach the building, ComLab 8 can be easily found on the ground floor.
ceb: Nahimutang sa 1st floor sa Secondary School Laboratory Building.
Kining bilding nahimutang tapad sa University Press Building ug diretso sa atubangan sa parking area sa P.A. Ramos Street.
Kung moabot ka sa bilding, sayon makita ang ComLab 8 sa ground floor.

en: Faculty Room 102 is located on the 1st floor of the College of Education Building.
It is near the main entrance and assigned to Prof. Cruz.
ceb: Nahimutang ang Faculty Room 102 sa 1st floor sa College of Education Building.
Duol kini sa main entrance ug assigned kang Prof. Cruz.

en: The comfort room on the 3rd floor of the Finance Building is near ComLab 5.
Follow the hallway to reach it.
ceb: Ang comfort room sa 3rd floor sa Finance Building nahimutang duol sa ComLab 5.
Sunda lang ang hallway para maabot kini.

en: Classroom 204 is located on the 2nd floor of the Science Building.
It is at the end of the corridor, beside the Chemistry Lab.
ceb: Nahimutang ang Classroom 204 sa 2nd floor sa Science Building.
Anaa kini sa tumoy sa corridor, tapad sa Chemistry Lab.
